newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan firms in T$8 bln semiconductor venture.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan firms in T$8 bln semiconductor venture.

text.p: Taiwan's Winbond Electronics Corp and China Development Corp will invest in a semiconductor wafer plant at northern Hsinchu Science Park, Winbond said in a statement on Friday.

The new plant at the island's high-technology centre is capitalised at T$8 billion, and is expected to begin production in the second half of 1998, Winbond, Taiwan's third-biggest semiconductor maker, said.
"The new plant will give a positive boost to the sluggish semiconductor industry," it said.
It did not give ownership details.
China Development Corp is one of Taiwan's leading venture capital and investment firms.
Many analysts and local electronics firms have expected a recovery in the semiconductor industry in 1997, after the sector suffered a fierce price war in 1996.
